notes.title: 🔷New Multiplayer Mode! (Soon) +🔶RPG Maker Fest 2025
notes.content:
We're Part of RPG Maker Fest 2025!

We’re beyond excited to share that Laser Tanks is officially part of RPG Maker Fest 2025! To mark this huge milestone, we’re introducing an all-new Multiplayer Mode, designed for high-speed, head-to-head combat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956492/79306a55119b09f2c38a6198a8a4f789f3f13e80.png

🔥 1v1 Battles. Three Rounds. One Winner. 🔥

🚀 Round 2 – Launching: Lock and load the Rocket Launcher—secure 10 eliminations to dominate.
🚜 Round 3 – Tanking: Roll into Tank Warfare—first to 5 tank kills takes it all!

This is just the beginning—stay tuned for more modes, updates, and surprises coming soon! 🔥

notes.title: Major Update: Laser Tanks v1.0.2
notes.content:
We are excited to present Laser Tanks v1.0.2, our biggest update yet, with thrilling new features, epic tunes, and key bug fixes that elevate your tank warfare experience to a whole new level!

[previewyoutube=w3pIM5arRnA;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2309830/Laser_Tanks/

🎮 NEW FEATURES

🖥️ CRT Graphical Effects:
Dive into tank battles with retro-style graphics that bring back the arcade days, with a cool CRT effect to make your gameplay experience even more immersive.
(A must-try for anyone who loves the nostalgic, retro vibes!)

⏱️ Slow Motion:
Take control of time with the all-new slow-motion feature, giving you the edge to plan every shot with precision and dominate your enemies in style!
(Perfect for those intense battles where timing is everything.)

⚡ Fast-Paced Gameplay:
Amp up the excitement with faster gameplay that keeps you on your toes. Brace yourself for quick reflexes and non-stop action!
(Great for players who thrive on rapid-fire, action-packed gameplay.)

💥 Dash Mechanic:
Now you can dash across the battlefield! Quickly dodge incoming attacks and outflank your enemies with this new movement option.

🎸 Rock BGM:
Battle it out to new Rock music tracks that crank up the intensity of every fight. Your tank isn’t the only thing with firepower—these beats are sure to fuel your battle spirit!
(Let the heavy tunes amp up the energy of your fights!)



🔨 FIXES

🛠️ Tank Clipping Issue Resolved:
Fixed a bug where tanks would clip through the terrain during combat. Enjoy smoother gameplay!

❄️ Turret Freeze Bug Fixed:
Resolved the problem where the turret would freeze during high-speed movement, ensuring flawless tank maneuvers!

🔧 UI Glitches Fixed:
Corrected multiple UI glitches in the mission select menu for a better interface experience.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hey, Tank Commanders!

We’ve rolled out a small update for Laser Tanks to address some of the bugs reported by our amazing community. This patch doesn’t contain any major changes but aims to make your gameplay experience smoother and more enjoyable!

Patch Notes:

Minor Bug Fixes & Improvements:

🛠️ Fixed an issue where enemy tanks occasionally got stuck in walls.
🛠️ Resolved a bug that caused the game to freeze when entering certain levels.
🛠️ Fixed a rare crash related to tank upgrades.
🛠️ Corrected minor visual glitches on the in-game HUD.

What’s Next:
We’re committed to refining and enhancing Laser Tanks based on your feedback. Stay tuned for more updates and features coming soon!

notes.title: Introducing "DUNGEON SURVIVORS MODE" in Laser Tanks!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956492/aabeb097f1ce1ed14aa156ddad6886a4c74d09a3.png

Prepare for an electrifying experience in the latest Laser Tanks update! Introducing the thrilling "Dungeon Survivor Mode," where the battle against alien invaders and rival tanks never ends.

Some Survivor Cards 🃏 :
- ⚡ Electric Shocks
- ☄️ Meteors Drops
- 💉 Gradual Heal
- 🩸 One-Time Heal
- 🌪️ Spin Squash
- 🔫 Weapons
- 🛡️ Shields

Get ready to take your Laser Tanks experience to a whole new level with our latest update. We're thrilled to introduce "Survivor Mode," an endless battle against relentless aliens and formidable tanks. But that's not all – we're adding a new twist to the action with the introduction of "PROTONS."

In Survivor Mode, your objective is to survive wave after wave of alien attacks and enemy tanks, putting your skills to the ultimate test. What makes this mode truly exciting are the PROTONS, unique collectibles scattered throughout the battlefield. Gather these mysterious energy sources to unlock incredible abilities that can turn the tide of battle in your favor.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956492/ceb73b5a804990e71fdbcfe2688b10521c59ecf1.png

Discover the power of "ELECTRIC SHOCK," a devastating attack that electrifies your enemies with a surge of energy. Rain down destruction with "METEORS DROP," summoning celestial projectiles to obliterate foes. Need a breather? Activate "GRADUAL HEAL" to restore your tank's vitality over time.

With the "DUNGEON SURVIVOR" update, Laser Tanks becomes more challenging and strategic than ever before. How long can you survive? Will you master the use of PROTONS and become an unstoppable force on the battlefield? Jump into the action and find out! It's time to rewrite your Laser Tanks legacy and show the aliens who's boss. Get ready to conquer the "DUNGEON SURVIVOR" mode and unleash the power of the PROTONS!
